decision_unit: one drift vector between consecutive keypoints within an original LiMOSAT trajectory

parameters.configured_speed_m_per_day: required from the source tracking run

neighbour_model.prediction_guard: Use coordinate-median translation when affine prediction weights have L1 norm > 2 or the fit is rank deficient.
neighbour_model.final_fit: Refit on the final clipped inlier set before reporting residuals.

automatic_rejection.strong_local_candidate: supported residual > max(10000 m, local median + 8 robust scales)
automatic_rejection.ultra_local: supported residual > max(20000 m, local median + 8 robust scales)
automatic_rejection.topology_local: strong local candidate incident on an orientation reversal in a source Delaunay triangle with maximum edge <= 20000 m
automatic_rejection.speed_local: actual-gap speed above the source-run configured limit and supported residual > max(5000 m, local median + 6 robust scales)

retained_for_review: strong local candidates not meeting an automatic rejection rule

split_semantics.rule: the target keypoint of each rejected vector begins a new trajectory segment
split_semantics.new_ids: deterministic integers above the maximum original trajectory ID
split_semantics.converged_to: archive finalizer maps to the latest split segment at or before the convergence row time and image
split_semantics.duplicate_points: exclude additional trajectory/image/time rows from scoring and preserve them as deterministic singleton trajectories
split_semantics.source_terminal_validation: Refuse source terminal markers preceding another observation of the same trajectory; duplicates at the terminal image/time are allowed.

archive_prescreen: Skip local fits only when coarse residual + 2 * maximum neighbour deviation from the coarse median is below both the prescreen and every local decision floor.
